title: Compatibility Schema
description: Models evidence-backed compatibility relationships between Forge entities, powering the knowledge graph and recommendation engine to evaluate integrations, dependencies, and alternatives.

id.title: Compatibility ID
id.description: Unique identifier for this specific compatibility relationship.

source_entity.title: Source Entity
source_entity.description: Forge entity ID representing the source technology initiating the relationship.

target_entity.title: Target Entity
target_entity.description: Forge entity ID representing the target technology receiving the relationship.

relationship_type.title: Relationship Type
relationship_type.description: The nature of the directed relationship from the source to the target entity.

compatibility_level.title: Compatibility Level
compatibility_level.description: The qualitative assessment of the compatibility, stability, or integration quality.

official_support.title: Official Support
official_support.description: Indicates whether this integration or compatibility is officially supported and maintained by either the source or target developers.

integration_method.title: Integration Method
integration_method.description: The technical method, architecture, or mechanism by which these entities integrate.

integration_status.title: Integration Status
integration_status.description: The lifecycle and production readiness status of this specific integration or compatibility relationship.

version_constraints.title: Version Constraints
version_constraints.description: Specific version limitations, ranges, or requirements for the compatibility to be valid.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Optional notes, caveats, or specific implementation details regarding this relationship.
examples: Requires enabling the experimental API flag in version 1.10.0.

supporting_citations.title: Supporting Citations
supporting_citations.description: A required list of citations providing evidence for this compatibility relationship.

last_verified.title: Last Verified
last_verified.description: Timestamp indicating when this compatibility relationship was last validated or tested by Forge.
